title: When Content Is Naturally a List

blocks.content: Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
When Content Is Naturally a List
When content doesn't naturally feel like a paragraph, ask yourself following questions:

items: Is this a set of steps?
Is this a group of related items?

blocks.content: If the answer to any one of these questions is yes, a list is usually the right choice.
HTML provides two types of lists:

items: Unordered Lists: Used when the order of the items doesn't matter
Ordered Lists: Used when the item order matters
